Pair of Linear Equations: Class 10 board exam ka two-digit number word problem, step by step, from place value to the check.

• Let the number be 10x + y, so the reversed number is 10y + x
• Sum of digits: x + y = 9
• 9(10x + y) = 2(10y + x), so 88x = 11y, so y = 8x
• Substitute: x + 8x = 9, so x = 1 and y = 8
• The number is 18 (check: 9 × 18 = 162 = 2 × 81)
